title: Fall with gravity
prompt: Gravity pulls down at gravity pixels per second every second, and down is positive y. Return the velocity after one frame.
signature: func solve(velocity: Vector2, gravity: float, delta: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(velocity: Vector2, gravity: float, delta: float) -> Vector2:
	return velocity
hint: Only y changes. Either add to velocity.y, or add Vector2.DOWN times gravity times delta.
solution:
func solve(velocity: Vector2, gravity: float, delta: float) -> Vector2:
	return velocity + Vector2.DOWN * gravity * delta
